title: Juzz : 15
introduction:
SURAH BANI-ISRA’IL (CHILDREN OF ISRAEL)

SURAH AL-KAHF (THE CAVE)

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ

سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِىْۤ اَسْرٰى بِعَبْدِهٖ لَيْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ اِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَا الَّذِىْ بٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهٗ لِنُرِيَهٗ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا‌ ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ‏(1)
verses.translation: (1) Glory be to Him Who made His servant to go on a night from the Sacred Mosque to the remote mosque of which We have blessed the precincts, so that We may show to him some of Our signs; surely He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

verses.arabic: وَاٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىْۤ اِسْرَآءِيْلَ اَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِىْ وَكِيْلًا ؕ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) And We gave Musa the Book and made it a guidance to the children of Israel, saying: Do not take a protector besides Me;

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوْحٍ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُوْرًا‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) The offspring of those whom We bore with Nuh; surely he was a grateful servant.

verses.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَاۤ اِلٰى بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And We had made known to the children of Israel in the Book: Most certainly you will make mischief in the land twice, and most certainly you will behave insolently with great insolence.

verses.arabic: فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ اُوْلٰٮهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَاۤ اُولِىْ بَاْسٍ شَدِيْدٍ فَجَاسُوْا خِلٰلَ الدِّيَارِ ‌ؕ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُوْلًا‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) So when the promise for the first of the two came, We sent over you Our servants, of mighty prowess, so they went to and fro among the houses, and it was a promise to be accomplished.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ الْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاَمْدَدْنٰكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّبَنِيْنَ وَجَعَلْنٰكُمْ اَكْثَرَ نَفِيْرًا‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Then We gave you back the turn to prevail against them, and aided you with wealth and children and made you a numerous band.

verses.arabic: اِنْ اَحْسَنْتُمْ اَحْسَنْتُمْ لِاَنْفُسِكُمْ‌وَاِنْ اَسَاْتُمْ فَلَهَا ‌ؕ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةِ لِيَسُوْۤءا وُجُوْهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا الْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوْهُ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّلِيُتَبِّرُوْا مَا عَلَوْا تَتْبِيْرًا‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) If you do good, you will do good for your own souls, and if you do evil, it shall be for them. So when the second promise came (We raised another people) that they may bring you to grief and that they may enter the mosque as they entered it the first time, and that they might destroy whatever they gained ascendancy over with utter destruction.

verses.arabic: عَسٰى رَبُّكُمْ اَنْ يَّرْحَمَكُمْ‌ ۚ وَاِنْ عُدْتُّمْ عُدْنَا‌ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ حَصِيْرًا‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) It may be that your Lord will have mercy on you, and if you again return (to disobedience) We too will return (to punishment), and We have made hell a prison for the unbelievers.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ يَهْدِىْ لِلَّتِىْ هِىَ اَقْوَمُ وَ يُبَشِّرُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ يَعْمَلُوْنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَبِيْرًا ۙ‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) Surely this Quran guides to that which is most upright and gives good news to the believers who do good that they shall have a great reward.

verses.arabic: وَّاَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ اَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) And that (as for) those who do not believe in the hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful chastisement.

verses.arabic: وَيَدْعُ الْاِنْسَانُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهٗ بِالْخَيْرِ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ عَجُوْلًا‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) And man prays for evil as he ought to pray for good, and man is ever hasty.

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ اٰيَتَيْنِ‌ فَمَحَوْنَاۤ اٰيَةَ الَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَاۤ اٰيَةَ النَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوْا فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوْا عَدَدَ السِّنِيْنَ وَالْحِسَابَ‌ؕ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَصَّلْنٰهُ تَفْصِيْلًا‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) And We have made the night and the day two signs, then We have made the sign of the night to pass away and We have made the sign of the day manifest, so that you may seek grace from your Lord, and that you might know the numbering of years and the reckoning; and We have explained everything with distinctness.

verses.arabic: وَكُلَّ اِنْسَانٍ اَلْزَمْنٰهُ طٰۤئِرَهٗ فِىْ عُنُقِهٖ‌ؕ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ كِتٰبًا يَّلْقٰٮهُ مَنْشُوْرًا‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) And We have made every man's actions to cling to his neck, and We will bring forth to him on the resurrection day a book which he will find wide open:

verses.arabic: اِقْرَاْ كِتٰبَك َؕ كَفٰى بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيْبًا ؕ‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) Read your book; your own self is sufficient as a reckoner against you this day.

verses.arabic: مَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَاِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِىْ لِنَفْسِهٖ ‌ۚ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا‌ ؕ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزْرَ اُخْرٰى‌ ؕ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِيْنَ حَتّٰى نَبْعَثَ رَسُوْلًا‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) Whoever goes aright, for his own soul does he go aright; and whoever goes astray, to its detriment only does he go astray: nor can the bearer of a burden bear the burden of another, nor do We chastise until We raise an apostle.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَاۤ اَرَدْنَاۤ اَنْ نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً اَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيْهَا فَفَسَقُوْا فِيْهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا الْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنٰهَا تَدْمِيْرًا‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) And when We wish to destroy a town, We send Our commandment to the people of it who lead easy lives, but they transgress therein; thus the word proves true against it, so We destroy it with utter destruction.

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ الْقُرُوْنِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ نُوْحٍ‌ؕ وَكَفٰى بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوْبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرًۢا بَصِيْرًا‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) And how many of the generations did We destroy after Nuh! and your Lord is sufficient as Knowing and Seeing with regard to His servants' faults.

verses.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ الْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهٗ فِيْهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَنْ نُّرِيْدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَ‌ۚ يَصْلٰٮهَا مَذْمُوْمًا مَّدْحُوْرًا‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) Whoever desires this present life, We hasten to him therein what We please for whomsoever We desire, then We assign to him the hell; he shall enter it despised, driven away.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ اَرَادَ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَسَعٰى لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَاُولٰۤئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) And whoever desires the hereafter and strives for it as he ought to strive and he is a believer; (as for) these, their striving shall surely be accepted.

verses.arabic: كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ وَهٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ‌ ؕ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُوْرًا‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) All do We aid-- these as well as those-- out of the bounty of your Lord, and the bounty of your Lord is not confined.

verses.arabic: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ‌ ؕ وَلَلْاٰخِرَةُ اَكْبَرُ دَرَجٰتٍ وَّاَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيْلًا‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) See how We have made some of them to excel others, and certainly the hereafter is much superior in respect of excellence.

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُوْمًا مَّخْذُوْلًا‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) Do not associate with Allah any other god, lest you sit down despised, neglected.

verses.arabic: وَقَضٰى رَبُّكَ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ اِحْسَانًا‌ ؕ اِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِنْدَكَ الْكِبَرَ اَحَدُهُمَاۤ اَوْ كِلٰهُمَا فَلَا تَقُلْ لَّهُمَاۤ اُفٍّ وَّلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُلْ لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيْمًا‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And your Lord has commanded that you shall not serve (any) but Him, and goodness to your parents. If either or both of them reach old age with you, say not to them (so much as) "Ugh" nor chide them, and speak to them a generous word.

verses.arabic: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُلْ رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيٰنِىْ صَغِيْرًا ؕ‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) And make yourself submissively gentle to them with compassion, and say: O my Lord! have compassion on them, as they brought me up (when I was) little.

verses.arabic: رَّبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِىْ نُفُوْسِكُمْ‌ؕ اِنْ تَكُوْنُوْا صٰلِحِيْنَ فَاِنَّهٗ كَانَ لِلْاَوَّابِيْنَ غَفُوْرًا‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) Your Lord knows best what is in your minds; if you are good, then He is surely Forgiving to those who turn (to Him) frequently.

verses.arabic: وَاٰتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَالْمِسْكِيْنَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيْلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيْرًا‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) And give to the near of kin his due and (to) the needy and the wayfarer, and do not squander wastefully.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِيْنَ كَانُوْۤا اِخْوَانَ الشَّيٰطِيْنِ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطٰنُ لِرَبِّهٖ كَفُوْرًا‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) Surely the squanderers are the fellows of the Shaitans and the Shaitan is ever ungrateful to his Lord.

verses.arabic: وَاِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ابْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوْهَا فَقُلْ لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُوْرًا‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) And if you turn away from them to seek mercy from your Lord, which you hope for, speak to them a gentle word.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُوْلَةً اِلٰى عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُوْمًا مَّحْسُوْرًا‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) And do not make your hand to be shackled to your neck nor stretch it forth to the utmost (limit) of its stretching forth, lest you should (afterwards) sit down blamed, stripped off.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرًۢا بَصِيْرًا‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) Surely your Lord makes plentiful the means of subsistence for whom He pleases and He straitens (them); surely He is ever Aware of, Seeing, His servants.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوْۤا اَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ اِمْلَاقٍ‌ؕ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَاِيَّاكُمْ‌ؕ اِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْاً كَبِيْرًا‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) And do not kill your children for fear of poverty; We give them sustenance and yourselves (too); surely to kill them is a great wrong.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنٰٓى اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً  ؕ وَسَآءَ سَبِيْلًا‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) And go not nigh to fornication; surely it is an indecency and an evil way.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِىْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ‌ ؕ وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مَظْلُوْمًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهٖ سُلْطٰنًا فَلَا يُسْرِفْ فِّى الْقَتْلِ‌ ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مَنْصُوْرًا‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) And do not kill any one whom Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause, and whoever is slain unjustly, We have indeed given to his heir authority, so let him not exceed the just limits in slaying; surely he is aided.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوْا مَالَ الْيَتِيْمِ اِلَّا بِالَّتِىْ هِىَ اَحْسَنُ حَتّٰى يَبْلُغَ اَشُدَّهٗ‌ وَاَوْفُوْا بِالْعَهْدِ‌ۚ اِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْئُوْلًا‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And draw not near to the property of the orphan except in a goodly way till he attains his maturity and fulfill the promise; surely (every) promise shall be questioned about.

verses.arabic: وَاَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ اِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوْا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيْمِ‌ؕ ذٰ لِكَ خَيْرٌ وَّاَحْسَنُ تَاْوِيْلًا‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) And give full measure when you measure out, and weigh with a true balance; this is fair and better in the end.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلْمٌ‌ ؕ اِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ اُولٰۤئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُوْلًا‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) And follow not that of which you have not the knowledge; surely the hearing and the sight and the heart, all of these, shall be questioned about that.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَرَحًا‌ ۚ اِنَّكَ لَنْ تَخْرِقَ الْاَرْضَ وَلَنْ تَبْلُغَ الْجِبَالَ طُوْلًا‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) And do not go about in the land exultingly, for you cannot cut through the earth nor reach the mountains in height.

verses.arabic: كُلُّ ذٰ لِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوْهًا‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) All this-- the evil of it-- is hateful in the sight of your Lord.

verses.arabic: ذٰ لِكَ مِمَّاۤ اَوْحٰۤى اِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ‌ ؕ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتُلْقٰى فِىْ جَهَنَّمَ مَلُوْمًا مَّدْحُوْرًا‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) This is of what your Lord has revealed to you of wisdom, and do not associate any other god with Allah lest you should be thrown into hell, blamed, cast away.

verses.arabic: اَفَاَصْفٰٮكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِالْبَنِيْنَ وَ اتَّخَذَ مِنَ الْمَلٰۤئِكَةِ اِنَاثًا‌ ؕ اِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُوْلُوْنَ قَوْلًا عَظِيْمًا‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) What! has then your Lord preferred to give you sons, and (for Himself) taken daughters from among the angels? Most surely you utter a grievous saying.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِىْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوْا ؕ وَمَا يَزِيْدُهُمْ اِلَّا نُفُوْرًا‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) And certainly We have repeated (warnings) in this Quran that they may be mindful, but it does not add save to their aversion.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهٗۤ اٰلِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ اِذًا لَّابْتَغَوْا اِلٰى ذِى الْعَرْشِ سَبِيْلًا‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) Say: If there were with Him gods as they say, then certainly they would have been able to seek a way to the Lord of power.

verses.arabic: سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يَقُوْلُوْنَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيْرًا‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) Glory be to Him and exalted be He in high exaltation above what they say.

verses.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمٰوٰتُ السَّبْعُ وَالْاَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيْهِنَّ‌ؕ وَاِنْ مِّنْ شَىْءٍ اِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهٖ وَلٰكِنْ لَّا تَفْقَهُوْنَ تَسْبِيْحَهُمْ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ حَلِيْمًا غَفُوْرًا‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) The seven heavens declare His glory and the earth (too), and those who are in them; and there is not a single thing but glorifies Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification; surely He is Forbearing, Forgiving.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا قَرَاْتَ الْقُرْاٰنَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُوْرًا ۙ‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter a hidden barrier;

verses.arabic: وَّجَعَلْنَا عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ اَكِنَّةً اَنْ يَّفْقَهُوْهُ وَفِىْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا‌ ؕ وَاِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى الْقُرْاٰنِ وَحْدَهٗ وَلَّوْا عَلٰٓى اَدْبَارِهِمْ نُفُوْرًا‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) And We have placed coverings on their hearts and a heaviness in their ears lest they understand it, and when you mention your Lord alone in the Quran they turn their backs in aversion.

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُوْنَ بِهٖۤ اِذْ يَسْتَمِعُوْنَ اِلَيْكَ وَاِذْ هُمْ نَجْوٰٓى اِذْ يَقُوْلُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِنْ تَتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُوْرًا‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) We know best what they listen to when they listen to you, and when they take counsel secretly, when the unjust say: You follow only a man deprived of reason.

verses.arabic: اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْا لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ سَبِيْلًا‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) See what they liken you to! So they have gone astray and cannot find the way.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَّرُفَاتًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ خَلْقًا جَدِيْدًا‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And they say: What! when we shall have become bones and decayed particles, shall we then certainly be raised up, being a new creation?

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُوْنُوْا حِجَارَةً اَوْ حَدِيْدًا‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) Say: Become stones or iron,

verses.arabic: اَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِىْ صُدُوْرِكُمْ‌ۚ فَسَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَنْ يُّعِيْدُنَا‌ ؕ قُلِ الَّذِىْ فَطَرَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ‌ ۚ فَسَيُنْغِضُوْنَ اِلَيْكَ رُءُوْسَهُمْ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هُوَ‌ ؕ قُلْ عَسٰٓى اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ قَرِيْبًا‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) Or some other creature of those which are too hard (to receive life) in your minds! But they will say: Who will return us? Say: Who created you at first. Still they will shake their heads at you and say: When will it be? Say: Maybe it has drawn nigh.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَدْعُوْكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيْبُوْنَ بِحَمْدِهٖ وَتَظُنُّوْنَ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) On the day when He will call you forth, then shall you obey Him, giving Him praise, and you will think that you tarried but a little (while).

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ لِّعِبَادِىْ يَقُوْلُوا الَّتِىْ هِىَ اَحْسَنُ‌ؕ اِنَّ الشَّيْطٰنَ يَنْزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ‌ؕ اِنَّ الشَّيْطٰنَ كَانَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِيْنًا‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) And say to My servants (that) they speak that which is best; surely the Shaitan sows dissensions among them; surely the Shaitan is an open enemy to man.

verses.arabic: رَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ‌ؕ اِنْ يَّشَاْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ اَوْ اِنْ يَّشَاْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ ‌ؕ وَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيْلًا‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) Your Lord knows you best; He will have mercy on you if He pleases, or He will chastise you if He pleases; and We have not sent you as being in charge of them.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ؕ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ النَّبِيّٖنَ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ‌ وَّاٰتَيْنَا دَاوٗدَ زَبُوْرًا‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) And your Lord best knows those who are in the heavens and the earth; and certainly We have made some of the prophets to excel others, and to Dawood We gave a scripture.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِيْنَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَلَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيْلًا‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) Say: Call on those whom you assert besides Him, so they shall not control the removal of distress from you nor (its) transference.

verses.arabic: اُولٰۤئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ يَبْتَغُوْنَ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ اَيُّهُمْ اَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُوْنَ رَحْمَتَهٗ وَيَخَافُوْنَ عَذَابَهٗؕ اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُوْرًا‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord-- whoever of them is nearest-- and they hope for His mercy and fear His chastisement; surely the chastisement of your Lord is a thing to be cautious of.

verses.arabic: وَاِنْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوْهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ اَوْ مُعَذِّبُوْهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا‌ ؕ كَانَ ذٰ لِكَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَسْطُوْرًا‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) And there is not a town but We will destroy it before the day of resurrection or chastise it with a severe chastisement; this is written in the Divine ordinance.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَنَاۤ اَنْ نُّرْسِلَ بِالْاٰيٰتِ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ كَذَّبَ بِهَا الْاَوَّلُوْنَ‌ؕ وَاٰتَيْنَا ثَمُوْدَ النَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوْا بِهَا‌ؕ وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِالْاٰيٰتِ اِلَّا تَخْوِيْفًا‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) And nothing could have hindered Us that We should send signs except that the ancients rejected them; and We gave to Samood the she-camel-- a manifest sign-- but on her account they did injustice, and We do not send signs but to make (men) fear.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ اَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ‌ ؕ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّءْيَا الَّتِىْۤ اَرَيْنٰكَ اِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَ الشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُوْنَةَ فِى الْقُرْاٰنِ‌ ؕ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْۙ فَمَا يَزِيْدُهُمْ اِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيْرًا‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And when We said to you: Surely your Lord encompasses men; and We did not make the vision which We showed you but a trial for men and the cursed tree in the Quran as well; and We cause them to fear, but it only adds to their great inordinacy.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰۤئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِيْسَ قَالَ ءَاَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِيْنًا‌ ۚ‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) And when We said to the angels: Make obeisance to Adam; they made obeisance, but Iblis (did it not). He said: Shall I make obeisance to him whom Thou hast created of dust?

verses.arabic: قَالَ اَرَءَيْتَكَ هٰذَا الَّذِىْ كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ اَخَّرْتَنِ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ لَاَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهٗۤ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) He said: Tell me, is this he whom Thou hast honored above me? If Thou shouldst respite me to the day of resurrection, I will most certainly cause his progeny to perish except a few.

verses.arabic: قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَمَنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءً مَّوْفُوْرًا‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) He said: Be gone! for whoever of them will follow you, then surely hell is your recompense, a full recompense:

verses.arabic: وَاسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُمْ بِصَوْتِكَ وَاَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِمْ بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى الْاَمْوَالِ وَالْاَوْلَادِ وَعِدْهُمْ‌ ؕ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اِلَّا غُرُوْرًا‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) And beguile whomsoever of them you can with your voice, and collect against them your forces riding and on foot, and share with them in wealth and children, and hold out promises to them; and the Shaitan makes not promises to them but to deceive:

verses.arabic: اِنَّ عِبَادِىْ لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنٌ‌ ؕ وَكَفٰى بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيْلًا‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) Surely (as for) My servants, you have no authority over them; and your Lord is sufficient as a Protector.

verses.arabic: رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِىْ يُزْجِىْ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِى الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيْمًا‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) Your Lord is He Who speeds the ships for you in the sea that you may seek of His grace; surely He is ever Merciful to you.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِى الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَنْ تَدْعُوْنَ اِلَّاۤ اِيَّاهُ‌ ۚ فَلَمَّا نَجّٰٮكُمْ اِلَى الْبَرِّ اَعْرَضْتُمْ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ كَفُوْرًا‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) And when distress afflicts you in the sea, away go those whom you call on except He; but when He brings you safe to the land, you turn aside; and man is ever ungrateful.

verses.arabic: اَفَاَمِنْتُمْ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ الْبَرِّ اَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوْالَكُمْ وَكِيْلًا ۙ‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) What! Do you then feel secure that He will not cause a tract of land to engulf you or send on you a tornado? Then you shall not find a protector for yourselves.

verses.arabic: اَمْ اَمِنْتُمْ اَنْ يُّعِيْدَكُمْ فِيْهِ تَارَةً اُخْرٰى فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ الرِّيْحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُمْ بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ‌ۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوْا لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهٖ تَبِيْعًا‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) Or, do you feel secure that He will (not) take you back into it another time, then send on you a fierce gale and thus drown you on account of your ungratefulness? Then you shall not find any aider against Us in the matter.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىْۤ اٰدَمَ وَحَمَلْنٰهُمْ فِى الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنٰهُمْ عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيْلًا‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) And surely We have honored the children of Adam, and We carry them in the land and the sea, and We have given them of the good things, and We have made them to excel by an appropriate excellence over most of those whom We have created.

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَدْعُوْا كُلَّ اُنَاسٍۢ بِاِمَامِهِمْ‌ۚ فَمَنْ اُوْتِىَ كِتٰبَهٗ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ فَاُولٰۤئِكَ يَقْرَءُوْنَ كِتٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ فَتِيْلًا‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) (Remember) the day when We will call every people with their Imam; then whoever is given his book in his right hand, these shall read their book; and they shall not be dealt with a whit unjustly.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ كَانَ فِىْ هٰذِهٖۤ اَعْمٰى فَهُوَ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ اَعْمٰى وَاَضَلُّ سَبِيْلًا‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) And whoever is blind in this, he shall (also) be blind in the hereafter; and more erring from the way.

verses.arabic: وَاِنْ كَادُوْا لَيَفْتِنُوْنَكَ عَنِ الَّذِىْۤ اَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهٗ‌ ‌ۖ  وَاِذًا لَّاتَّخَذُوْكَ خَلِيْلًا‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) And surely they had purposed to turn you away from that which We have revealed to you, that you should forge against Us other than that, and then they would certainly have taken you for a friend.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَاۤ اَنْ ثَبَّتْنٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدْتَّ تَرْكَنُ اِلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا قَلِيْلًا  ۙ‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) And had it not been that We had already established you, you would certainly have been near to incline to them a little;

verses.arabic: اِذًا لَّاَذَقْنٰكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيٰوةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيْرًا‏(75)
verses.translation: (75) In that case We would certainly have made you to taste a double (punishment) in this life and a double (punishment) after death, then you would not have found any helper against Us.

verses.arabic: وَاِنْ كَادُوْا لَيَسْتَفِزُّوْنَكَ مِنَ الْاَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوْكَ مِنْهَا‌ وَاِذًا لَّا يَلْبَثُوْنَ خِلٰفَكَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا‏(76)
verses.translation: (76) And surely they purposed to unsettle you from the land that they might expel you from it, and in that case they will not tarry behind you but a little.

verses.arabic: سُنَّةَ مَنْ قَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنْ رُّسُلِنَا‌ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيْلًا‏(77)
verses.translation: (77) (This is Our) course with regard to those of Our apostles whom We sent before you, and you shall not find a change in Our course.

verses.arabic: اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِدُلُوْكِ الشَّمْسِ اِلٰى غَسَقِ الَّيْلِ وَقُرْاٰنَ الْفَجْرِ‌ؕ اِنَّ قُرْاٰنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُوْدًا‏(78)
verses.translation: (78) Keep up prayer from the declining of the sun till the darkness of the night and the morning recitation; surely the morning recitation is witnessed.

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهٖ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ ‌ۖ  عَسٰۤى اَنْ يَّبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُوْدًا‏(79)
verses.translation: (79) And during a part of the night, pray Tahajjud beyond what is incumbent on you; maybe your Lord will raise you to a position of great glory.

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ رَّبِّ اَدْخِلْنِىْ مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَّ اَخْرِجْنِىْ مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَّاجْعَلْ لِّىْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ سُلْطٰنًا نَّصِيْرًا‏(80)
verses.translation: (80) And say: My Lord! make me to enter a goodly entering, and cause me to go forth a goodly going forth, and grant me from near Thee power to assist (me).

verses.arabic: وَقُلْ جَآءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ‌ؕ اِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوْقًا‏(81)
verses.translation: (81) And say: The truth has come and the falsehood has vanished; surely falsehood is a vanishing (thing).

verses.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ‌ۙ وَلَا يَزِيْدُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ اِلَّا خَسَارًا‏(82)
verses.translation: (82) And We reveal of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy to the believers, and it adds only to the perdition of the unjust.

verses.arabic: وَاِذَاۤ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ اَعْرَضَ وَنَاٰ بِجَانِبِهٖ‌ۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَئُوْسًا‏(83)
verses.translation: (83) And when We bestow favor on man, he turns aside and behaves proudly, and when evil afflicts him, he is despairing.

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ يَّعْمَلُ عَلٰى شَاكِلَتِهٖؕ فَرَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ اَهْدٰى سَبِيْلًا‏(84)
verses.translation: (84) Say: Every one acts according to his manner; but your Lord best knows who is best guided in the path.

verses.arabic: وَيَسْئَلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الرُّوْحِ‌ ؕ قُلِ الرُّوْحُ مِنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّىْ وَمَاۤ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا‏(85)
verses.translation: (85) And they ask you about the soul. Say: The soul is one of the commands of my Lord, and you are not given aught of knowledge but a little.

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِىْۤ اَوْحَيْنَاۤ اِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهٖ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيْلًا ۙ‏(86)
verses.translation: (86) And if We please, We should certainly take away that which We have revealed to you, then you would not find for it any protector against Us.

verses.arabic: اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ‌ ؕ اِنَّ فَضْلَهٗ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيْرًا‏(87)
verses.translation: (87) But on account of mercy from your Lord-- surely His grace to you is abundant.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لَّئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْاِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلٰٓى اَنْ يَّاْتُوْا بِمِثْلِ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ لَا يَاْتُوْنَ بِمِثْلِهٖ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيْرًا‏(88)
verses.translation: (88) Say: If men and jinn should combine together to bring the like of this Quran, they could not bring the like of it, though some of them were aiders of others.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِىْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَاَبٰٓى اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا‏(89)
verses.translation: (89) And certainly We have explained for men in this Quran every kind of similitude, but most men do not consent to aught but denying.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوْا لَنْ نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰى تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْاَرْضِ يَنْۢبُوْعًا ۙ‏(90)
verses.translation: (90) And they say: We will by no means believe in you until you cause a fountain to gush forth from the earth for us.

verses.arabic: اَوْ تَكُوْنَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّنْ نَّخِيْلٍ وَّعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْاَنْهٰرَ خِلٰلَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا ۙ‏(91)
verses.translation: (91) Or you should have a garden of palms and grapes in the midst of which you should cause rivers to flow forth, gushing out.

verses.arabic: اَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا اَوْ تَاْتِىَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالْمَلٰۤئِكَةِ قَبِيْلًا ۙ‏(92)
verses.translation: (92) Or you should cause the heaven to come down upon us in pieces as you think, or bring Allah and the angels face to face (with us).

verses.arabic: اَوْ يَكُوْنَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّنْ زُخْرُفٍ اَوْ تَرْقٰى فِى السَّمَآءِ ؕ وَلَنْ نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتّٰى تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتٰبًا نَّقْرَؤُهٗ‌ ؕ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّىْ هَلْ كُنْتُ اِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُوْلًا‏(93)
verses.translation: (93) Or you should have a house of gold, or you should ascend into heaven, and we will not believe in your ascending until you bring down to us a book which we may read. Say: Glory be to my Lord; am I aught but a mortal apostle?

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنْ يُّؤْمِنُوْۤا اِذْ جَآءَهُمُ الْهُدٰٓى اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوْۤا اَبَعَثَ اللّٰهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُوْلًا‏(94)
verses.translation: (94) And nothing prevented people from believing when the guidance came to them except that they said: What! has Allah raised up a mortal to be an apostle?

verses.arabic: قُلْ لَّوْ كَانَ فِى الْاَرْضِ مَلٰۤئِكَةٌ يَّمْشُوْنَ مُطْمَئِنِّيْنَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُوْلًا‏(95)
verses.translation: (95) Say: Had there been in the earth angels walking about as settlers, We would certainly have sent down to them from the heaven an angel as an apostle.

verses.arabic: قُلْ كَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ شَهِيْدًۢا بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَكُمْ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرًۢا بَصِيْرًا‏(96)
verses.translation: (96) Say: Allah suffices as a witness between me and you; surely He is Aware of His servants, Seeing.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ‌ ۚ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهُمْ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ‌ ؕ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَّبُكْمًا وَّصُمًّا‌ ؕ مَاْوٰٮهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ‌ ؕ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنٰهُمْ سَعِيْرًا‏(97)
verses.translation: (97) And whomsoever Allah guides, he is the follower of the right way, and whomsoever He causes to err, you shall not find for him guardians besides Him; and We will gather them together on the day of resurrection on their faces, blind and dumb and deaf; their abode is hell; whenever it becomes allayed We will add to their burning.

verses.arabic: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَّرُفَاتًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ خَلْقًا جَدِيْدًا‏(98)
verses.translation: (98) This is their retribution because they disbelieved in Our communications and said What! when we shall have become bones and decayed particles, shall we then indeed be raised up into a new creation?

verses.arabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلٰٓى اَنْ يَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ اَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ ؕ فَاَبَى الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا‏(99)
verses.translation: (99) Do they not consider that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create their like, and He has appointed for them a doom about which there is no doubt? But the unjust do not consent to aught but denying.

verses.arabic: قُلْ لَّوْ اَنْتُمْ تَمْلِكُوْنَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىْۤ اِذًا لَّاَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْاِنْفَاقِ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ قَتُوْرًا‏(100)
verses.translation: (100) Say: If you control the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold (them) from fear of spending, and man is niggardly.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰى تِسْعَ اٰيٰتٍۢ بَيِّنٰتٍ‌ فَسْئَلْ بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ اِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهٗ فِرْعَوْنُ اِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰمُوْسٰى مَسْحُوْرًا‏(101)
verses.translation: (101) And certainly We gave Musa nine clear signs; so ask the children of Israel. When he came to them, Firon said to him: Most surely I deem you, O Musa, to be a man deprived of reason.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَاۤ اَنْزَلَ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ اِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ‌ ۚ وَاِنِّىْ لَاَظُنُّكَ يٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُوْرًا‏(102)
verses.translation: (102) He said: Truly you know that none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth has sent down these as clear proof and most surely I believe you, O Firon, to be given over to perdition.

verses.arabic: فَاَرَادَ اَنْ يَّسْتَفِزَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُ وَ مَنْ مَّعَهٗ جَمِيْعًا ۙ‏(103)
verses.translation: (103) So he desired to destroy them out of the earth, but We drowned him and those with him all together;

verses.arabic: وَّقُلْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ لِبَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ اسْكُنُوا الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ الْاٰخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيْفًا ؕ‏(104)
verses.translation: (104) And We said to the Israelites after him: Dwell in the land: and when the promise of the next life shall come to pass, we will bring you both together in Judgement.

verses.arabic: وَبِالْحَقِّ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ‌ ؕ وَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيْرًا ‌ۘ‏(105)
verses.translation: (105) And with truth have We revealed it, and with truth did it come; and We have not sent you but as the giver of good news and as a warner.

verses.arabic: وَقُرْاٰنًا فَرَقْنٰهُ لِتَقْرَاَهٗ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلٰى مُكْثٍ وَّنَزَّلْنٰهُ تَنْزِيْلًا‏(106)
verses.translation: (106) And it is a Quran which We have revealed in portions so that you may read it to the people by slow degrees, and We have revealed it, revealing in portions.

verses.arabic: قُلْ اٰمِنُوْا بِهٖۤ اَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوْٓا‌ ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖۤ اِذَا يُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّوْنَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا ۙ‏(107)
verses.translation: (107) Say: Believe in it or believe not; surely those who are given the knowledge before it fall down on their faces, making obeisance when it is recited to them.

verses.arabic: وَّيَقُوْلُوْنَ سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّنَاۤ اِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُوْلًا‏(108)
verses.translation: (108) And they say: Glory be to our Lord! most surely the promise of our Lord was to be fulfilled.

verses.arabic: وَيَخِرُّوْنَ لِلْاَذْقَانِ يَبْكُوْنَ وَيَزِيْدُهُمْ خُشُوْعًا ۩‏(109)
verses.translation: (109) And they fall down on their faces weeping, and it adds to their humility.

verses.arabic: قُلِ ادْعُوا اللّٰهَ اَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمٰنَ‌ ؕ اَ يًّا مَّا تَدْعُوْا فَلَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰى ‌ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذٰ لِكَ سَبِيْلًا‏(110)
verses.translation: (110) Say: Call upon Allah or call upon, the Beneficent Allah; whichever you call upon, He has the best names; and do not utter your prayer with a very raised voice nor be silent with regard to it, and seek a way between these.

verses.arabic: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِيْكٌ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهٗ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ‌ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيْرًا‏(111)
verses.translation: (111) And say: (All) praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a son and Who has not a partner in the kingdom, and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace; and proclaim His greatness magnifying (Him).

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
اَ لْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىْۤ اَنْزَلَ عَلٰى عَبْدِهِ الْكِتٰبَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَّهٗ عِوَجًا  ؕ‏(1)
verses.translation: (1) (All) praise is due to Allah, Who revealed the Book to His servant and did not make in it any crookedness.

verses.arabic: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنْذِرَ بَاْسًا شَدِيْدًا مِّنْ لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ يَعْمَلُوْنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا حَسَنًا ۙ‏(2)
verses.translation: (2) Rightly directing, that he might give warning of severe punishment from Him and give good news to the believers who do good that they shall have a goodly reward,

verses.arabic: مّٰكِثِيْنَ فِيْهِ اَبَدًا ۙ‏(3)
verses.translation: (3) Staying in it for ever;

verses.arabic: وَّيُنْذِرَ الَّذِيْنَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًا‏(4)
verses.translation: (4) And warn those who say: Allah has taken a son.

verses.arabic: مَا لَهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ عِلْمٍ وَّلَا لِاٰبَآئِهِمْ‌ؕ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ اَفْوَاهِهِمْ‌ؕ اِنْ يَّقُوْلُوْنَ اِلَّا كَذِبًا‏(5)
verses.translation: (5) They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers; a grievous word it is that comes out of their mouths; they speak nothing but a lie.

verses.arabic: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلٰٓى اٰثَارِهِمْ اِنْ لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا بِهٰذَا الْحَدِيْثِ اَسَفًا‏(6)
verses.translation: (6) Then maybe you will kill yourself with grief, sorrowing after them, if they do not believe in this announcement.

verses.arabic: اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْاَرْضِ زِيْنَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ اَ يُّهُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا‏(7)
verses.translation: (7) Surely We have made whatever is on the earth an embellishment for it, so that We may try them (as to) which of them is best in works.

verses.arabic: وَاِنَّا لَجٰعِلُوْنَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيْدًا جُرُزًا ؕ‏(8)
verses.translation: (8) And most surely We will make what is on it bare ground without herbage.

verses.arabic: اَمْ حَسِبْتَ اَنَّ اَصْحٰبَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيْمِۙ كَانُوْا مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا عَجَبًا‏(9)
verses.translation: (9) Or, do you think that the Fellows of the Cave and the Inscription were of Our wonderful signs?

verses.arabic: اِذْ اَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ اِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَّهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ اَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا‏(10)
verses.translation: (10) When the youths sought refuge in the cave, they said: Our Lord! grant us mercy from Thee, and provide for us a right course in our affair.

verses.arabic: فَضَرَبْنَا عَلٰٓى اٰذَانِهِمْ فِى الْكَهْفِ سِنِيْنَ عَدَدًا ۙ‏(11)
verses.translation: (11) So We prevented them from hearing in the cave for a number of years.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنٰهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ اَىُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ اَحْصٰى لِمَا لَبِثُوْۤا اَمَدًا‏(12)
verses.translation: (12) Then We raised them up that We might know which of the two parties was best able to compute the time for which they remained.

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَاَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ اٰمَنُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنٰهُمْ هُدًى‌ۖ‏(13)
verses.translation: (13) We relate to you their story with the truth; surely they were youths who believed in their Lord and We increased them in guidance.

verses.arabic: وَّرَبَطْنَا عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ اِذْ قَامُوْا فَقَالُوْا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ لَنْ نَّدْعُوَا۫ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اِلٰهًا‌ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَاۤ اِذًا شَطَطًا‏(14)
verses.translation: (14) And We strengthened their hearts with patience, when they stood up and said: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth; we will by no means call upon any god besides Him, for then indeed we should have said an extravagant thing.

verses.arabic: هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ قَوْمُنَا اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً‌ ؕ لَوْ لَا يَاْتُوْنَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِسُلْطٰنٍۢ بَيِّنٍ‌ ؕ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا ؕ‏(15)
verses.translation: (15) These our people have taken gods besides Him; why do they not produce any clear authority in their support? Who is then more unjust than he who forges a lie against Allah?

verses.arabic: وَاِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوْهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ فَاْوٗۤا اِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنْشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِهٖ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَمْرِكُمْ مِّرْفَقًا‏(16)
verses.translation: (16) And when you forsake them and what they worship save Allah, betake yourselves for refuge to the cave; your Lord will extend to you largely of His mercy and provide for you a profitable course in your affair.

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ اِذَا طَلَعَتْ تَّزٰوَرُ عَنْ كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِيْنِ وَاِذَا غَرَبَتْ تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِىْ فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ‌ ؕ ذٰ لِكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ‌ ؕ مَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ‌ۚ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهٗ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا‏(17)
verses.translation: (17) And you might see the sun when it rose, decline from their cave towards the right hand, and when it set, leave them behind on the left while they were in a wide space thereof. This is of the signs of Allah; whomsoever Allah guides, he is the rightly guided one, and whomsoever He causes to err, you shall not find for him any friend to lead (him) aright.

verses.arabic: وَ تَحْسَبُهُمْ اَيْقَاظًا وَّهُمْ رُقُوْدٌ ‌‌ۖ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِيْنِ وَ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ‌‌ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُمْ بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيْدِ‌ ؕ لَوِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَّلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا‏(18)
verses.translation: (18) And you might think them awake while they were asleep and We turned them about to the right and to the left, while their dog (lay) outstretching its paws at the entrance; if you looked at them you would certainly turn back from them in flight, and you would certainly be filled with awe because of them.

verses.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ بَعَثْنٰهُمْ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوْا بَيْنَهُمْ‌ ؕ قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ؕ قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ‌ ؕ قَالُوْا رَبُّكُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ ؕ فَابْعَثُوْۤا اَحَدَكُمْ بِوَرِقِكُمْ هٰذِهٖۤ اِلَى الْمَدِيْنَةِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ اَيُّهَاۤ اَزْكٰى طَعَامًا فَلْيَاْتِكُمْ بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ اَحَدًا‏(19)
verses.translation: (19) And thus did We rouse them that they might question each other. A speaker among them said: How long have you tarried? They said: We have tarried for a day or a part of a day. (Others) said: Your Lord knows best how long you have tarried. Now send one of you with this silver (coin) of yours to the city, then let him see which of them has purest food, so let him bring you provision from it, and let him behave with gentleness, and by no means make your case known to any one:

verses.arabic: اِنَّهُمْ اِنْ يَّظْهَرُوْا عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوْكُمْ اَوْ يُعِيْدُوْكُمْ فِىْ مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَنْ تُفْلِحُوْۤا اِذًا اَبَدًا‏(20)
verses.translation: (20) For surely if they prevail against you they would stone you to death or force you back to their religion, and then you will never succeed.

verses.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوْۤا اَنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا ‌ۚ اِذْ يَتَنَازَعُوْنَ بَيْنَهُمْ اَمْرَهُمْ‌ فَقَالُوْا ابْنُوْا عَلَيْهِمْ بُنْيَانًا ‌ ؕ رَبُّهُمْ اَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ‌ؕ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ غَلَبُوْا عَلٰٓى اَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَّسْجِدًا‏(21)
verses.translation: (21) And thus did We make (men) to get knowledge of them that they might know that Allah's promise is true and that as for the hour there is no doubt about it. When they disputed among themselves about their affair and said: Erect an edifice over them-- their Lord best knows them. Those who prevailed in their affair said: We will certainly raise a masjid over them.

verses.arabic: سَيَقُوْلُوْنَ ثَلٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ‌ۚ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًۢا بِالْغَيْبِ‌ۚ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ سَبْعَةٌ وَّثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ‌ؕ قُلْ رَّبِّىْۤ اَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِمْ مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلٌ  فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيْهِمْ اِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَاهِرًا وَّلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيْهِمْ مِّنْهُمْ اَحَدًا‏(22)
verses.translation: (22) (Some) say: (They are) three, the fourth of them being their dog; and (others) say: Five, the sixth of them being their dog, making conjectures at what is unknown; and (others yet) say: Seven, and the eighth of them is their dog. Say: My Lord best knows their number, none knows them but a few; therefore contend not in the matter of them but with an outward contention, and do not question concerning them any of them.

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَقُوْلَنَّ لِشَاىْءٍ اِنِّىْ فَاعِلٌ ذٰ لِكَ غَدًا ۙ‏(23)
verses.translation: (23) And do not say of anything: Surely I will do it tomorrow,

verses.arabic: اِلَّاۤ اَنْ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ وَاذْكُرْ رَّبَّكَ اِذَا نَسِيْتَ وَقُلْ عَسٰٓى اَنْ يَّهْدِيَنِ رَبِّىْ لِاَقْرَبَ مِنْ هٰذَا رَشَدًا‏(24)
verses.translation: (24) Unless Allah pleases; and remember your Lord when you forget and say: Maybe my Lord will guide me to a nearer course to the right than this.

verses.arabic: وَلَبِثُوْا فِىْ كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلٰثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِيْنَ وَازْدَادُوْا تِسْعًا‏(25)
verses.translation: (25) And they remained in their cave three hundred years and (some) add (another) nine.

verses.arabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوْا‌ ۚ لَهٗ غَيْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ‌ ؕ اَبْصِرْ بِهٖ وَاَسْمِعْ‌ ؕ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِىٍّ  وَّلَا يُشْرِكُ فِىْ حُكْمِهٖۤ اَحَدًا‏(26)
verses.translation: (26) Say: Allah knows best how long they remained; to Him are (known) the unseen things of the heavens and the earth; how clear His sight and how clear His hearing! There is none to be a guardian for them besides Him, and He does not make any one His associate in His Judgement.

verses.arabic: وَاتْلُ مَاۤ اُوْحِىَ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ‌ؕ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهٖ‌ ۚ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًا‏(27)
verses.translation: (27) And recite what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord, there is none who can alter His words; and you shall not find any refuge besides Him.

verses.arabic: وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدٰوةِ وَالْعَشِىِّ يُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَهٗ‌ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنٰكَ عَنْهُمْ‌ ۚ تُرِيْدُ زِيْنَةَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا‌ ۚ وَ لَا تُطِعْ مَنْ اَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهٗ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰٮهُ وَكَانَ اَمْرُهٗ فُرُطًا‏(28)
verses.translation: (28) And withhold yourself with those who call on their Lord morning and evening desiring His goodwill, and let not your eyes pass from them, desiring the beauties of this world's life; and do not follow him whose heart We have made unmindful to Our remembrance, and he follows his low desires and his case is one in which due bounds are exceeded.

verses.arabic: وَقُلِ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكُمْ‌ فَمَنْ شَآءَ فَلْيُؤْمِنْ وَّمَنْ شَآءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ‌ۙاِنَّاۤ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ نَارًا ۙ اَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا‌ ؕ وَاِنْ يَّسْتَغِيْثُوْا يُغَاثُوْا بِمَآءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِى الْوُجُوْهَ‌ؕ بِئْسَ الشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا‏(29)
verses.translation: (29) And say: The truth is from your Lord, so let him who please believe, and let him who please disbelieve; surely We have prepared for the iniquitous a fire, the curtains of which shall encompass them about; and if they cry for water, they shall be given water like molten brass which will scald their faces; evil the drink and ill the resting-place.

verses.arabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيْعُ اَجْرَ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا‌ ۚ‏(30)
verses.translation: (30) Surely (as for) those who believe and do good, We do not waste the reward of him who does a good work.

verses.arabic: اُولٰۤئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِهِمُ الْاَنْهٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيْهَا مِنْ اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّ يَلْبَسُوْنَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِئِيْنَ فِيْهَا عَلَى الْاَرَآئِكِ‌ؕ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ ؕ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا‏(31)
verses.translation: (31) These it is for whom are gardens of perpetuity beneath which rivers flow, ornaments shall be given to them therein of bracelets of gold, and they shall wear green robes of fine silk and thick silk brocade interwoven with gold, reclining therein on raised couches; excellent the recompense and goodly the resting place.

verses.arabic: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِاَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ اَعْنَابٍ وَّحَفَفْنٰهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَّجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا ؕ‏(32)
verses.translation: (32) And set forth to them a parable of two men; for one of them We made two gardens of grape vines, and We surrounded them both with palms, and in the midst of them We made cornfields.

verses.arabic: كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ اٰتَتْ اُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِمْ مِّنْهُ شَيْئًا‌ ۙ وَّفَجَّرْنَا خِلٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًا ۙ‏(33)
verses.translation: (33) Both these gardens yielded their fruits, and failed not aught thereof, and We caused a river to gush forth in their midst,

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ لَهٗ ثَمَرٌ‌ ۚ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهٖ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗۤ اَنَا اَكْثَرُ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَّاَعَزُّ نَفَرًا‏(34)
verses.translation: (34) And he possessed much wealth; so he said to his companion, while he disputed with him: I have greater wealth than you, and am mightier in followers.

verses.arabic: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهٗ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهٖ‌ ۚ قَالَ مَاۤ اَظُنُّ اَنْ تَبِيْدَ هٰذِهٖۤ اَبَدًا ۙ‏(35)
verses.translation: (35) And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said: I do not think that this will ever perish

verses.arabic: وَّمَاۤ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً  ۙ وَّلَئِنْ رُّدِدْتُّ اِلٰى رَبِّىْ لَاَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنْقَلَبًا‏(36)
verses.translation: (36) And I do not think the hour will come, and even if I am returned to my Lord I will most certainly find a returning place better than this.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهٗ صَاحِبُهٗ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗۤ اَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِىْ خَلَقَكَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوّٰٮكَ رَجُلًاؕ‏(37)
verses.translation: (37) His companion said to him while disputing with him: Do you disbelieve in Him Who created you from dust, then from a small seed, then He made you a perfect man?

verses.arabic: لّٰكِنَّاۡ هُوَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّىْ وَلَاۤ اُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّىْۤ اَحَدًا‏(38)
verses.translation: (38) But as for me, He, Allah, is my Lord, and I do not associate anyone with my Lord.

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَاۤ اِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُ ۙ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ‌ ۚ اِنْ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًا‌ ۚ‏(39)
verses.translation: (39) And wherefore did you not say when you entered your garden: It is as Allah has pleased, there is no power save in Allah? If you consider me to be inferior to you in wealth and children,

verses.arabic: فَعَسٰى رَبِّىْۤ اَنْ يُّؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّنْ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيْدًا زَلَقًا ۙ‏(40)
verses.translation: (40) Then maybe my Lord will give me what is better than your garden, and send on it a thunderbolt from heaven so that it shall become even ground without plant,

verses.arabic: اَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيْعَ لَهٗ طَلَبًا‏(41)
verses.translation: (41) Or its waters should sink down into the ground so that you are unable to find it.

verses.arabic: وَاُحِيْطَ بِثَمَرِهٖ فَاَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَاۤ اَنْفَقَ فِيْهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلٰى عُرُوْشِهَا وَيَقُوْلُ يٰلَيْتَنِىْ لَمْ اُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّىْۤ اَحَدًا‏(42)
verses.translation: (42) And his wealth was destroyed; so he began to wring his hands for what he had spent on it, while it lay, having fallen down upon its roofs, and he said: Ah me! would that I had not associated anyone with my Lord.

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَّهٗ فِئَةٌ يَّنْصُرُوْنَهٗ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنْتَصِرًا ؕ‏(43)
verses.translation: (43) And he had no host to help him besides Allah nor could he defend himself.

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلّٰهِ الْحَقِّ‌ؕ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا‏(44)
verses.translation: (44) Here is protection only Allah's, the True One; He is best in (the giving of) reward and best in requiting.

verses.arabic: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الْاَرْضِ فَاَصْبَحَ هَشِيْمًا تَذْرُوْهُ الرِّيٰحُ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا‏(45)
verses.translation: (45) And set forth to them parable of the life of this world: like water which We send down from the cloud so the herbage of the earth becomes tangled on account of it, then it becomes dry broken into pieces which the winds scatter; and Allah is the holder of power over all things.

verses.arabic: اَلْمَالُ وَ الْبَنُوْنَ زِيْنَةُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا‌ ۚ وَالْبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيْرٌ اَمَلًا‏(46)
verses.translation: (46) Wealth and children are an adornment of the life of this world; and the ever-abiding, the good works, are better with your Lord in reward and better in expectation.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ و تَرَى الْاَرْضَ بَارِزَةً  ۙ وَّحَشَرْنٰهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ اَحَدًا‌ ۚ‏(47)
verses.translation: (47) And the day on which We will cause the mountains to pass away and you will see the earth a levelled plain and We will gather them and leave not any one of them behind.

verses.arabic: وَعُرِضُوْا عَلٰى رَبِّكَ صَفًّا ؕ لَقَدْ جِئْتُمُوْنَا كَمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۢ  بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ اَ لَّنْ نَّجْعَلَ لَكُمْ مَّوْعِدًا‏(48)
verses.translation: (48) And they shall be brought before your Lord, standing in ranks: Now certainly you have come to Us as We created you at first. Nay, you thought that We had not appointed to you a time of the fulfillment of the promise.

verses.arabic: وَوُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ فَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ مُشْفِقِيْنَ مِمَّا فِيْهِ وَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ يٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هٰذَا الْكِتٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيْرَةً وَّلَا كَبِيْرَةً اِلَّاۤ اَحْصٰٮهَا‌ ۚ وَوَجَدُوْا مَا عَمِلُوْا حَاضِرًا‌ ؕ وَ لَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ اَحَدًا‏(49)
verses.translation: (49) And the Book shall be placed, then you will see the guilty fearing from what is in it, and they will say: Ah! woe to us! what a book is this! it does not omit a small one nor a great one, but numbers them (all); and what they had done they shall find present (there); and your Lord does not deal unjustly with anyone.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰۤئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِيْسَؕ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ اَمْرِ رَبِّهٖؕ اَفَتَتَّخِذُوْنَهٗ وَذُرِّيَّتَهٗۤ اَوْلِيَآءَ مِنْ دُوْنِىْ وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ ؕ بِئْسَ لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ بَدَلًا‏(50)
verses.translation: (50) And when We said to the angels: Make obeisance to Adam; they made obeisance but Iblis (did it not). He was of the jinn, so he transgressed the commandment of his Lord. What! would you then take him and his offspring for friends rather than Me, and they are your enemies? Evil is (this) change for the unjust.

verses.arabic: مَّاۤ اَشْهَدْتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّيْنَ عَضُدًا‏(51)
verses.translation: (51) I did not make them witnesses of the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor of the creation of their own souls; nor could I take those who lead (others) astray for aiders.

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَقُوْلُ نَادُوْا شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِيْنَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيْبُوْا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَّوْبِقًا‏(52)
verses.translation: (52) And on the day when He shall say: Call on those whom you considered to be My associates. So they shall call on them, but they shall not answer them, and We will cause a separation between them.

verses.arabic: وَرَاَ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوْۤا اَنَّهُمْ مُّوَاقِعُوْهَا وَ لَمْ يَجِدُوْا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا‏(53)
verses.translation: (53) And the guilty shall see the fire, then they shall know that they are going to fall into it, and they shall not find a place to which to turn away from it.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِىْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ‌ ؕ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ اَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍ جَدَلًا‏(54)
verses.translation: (54) And certainly We have explained in this Quran every kind of example, and man is most of all given to contention.

verses.arabic: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنْ يُّؤْمِنُوْۤا اِذْ جَآءَهُمُ الْهُدٰى وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّهُمْ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ تَاْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا‏(55)
verses.translation: (55) And nothing prevents men from believing when the guidance comes to them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord, except that what happened to the ancients should overtake them, or that the chastisement should come face to face with them.

verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِيْنَ وَمُنْذِرِيْنَ‌ ۚ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوْا بِهِ الْحَقَّ‌ وَاتَّخَذُوْۤا اٰيٰتِىْ وَمَاۤ اُنْذِرُوْا هُزُوًا‏(56)
verses.translation: (56) And We do not send apostles but as givers of good news and warning, and those who disbelieve make a false contention that they may render null thereby the truth, and they take My communications and that with which they are warned for a mockery.

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ فَاَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدٰهُ‌ ؕ اِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ اَكِنَّةً اَنْ يَّفْقَهُوْهُ وَفِىْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا‌ ؕ وَاِنْ تَدْعُهُمْ اِلَى الْهُدٰى فَلَنْ يَّهْتَدُوْۤا اِذًا اَبَدًا‏(57)
verses.translation: (57) And who is more unjust than he who is reminded of the communications of his Lord, then he turns away from them and forgets what his two hands have sent before? Surely We have placed veils over their hearts lest they should understand it and a heaviness in their ears; and if you call them to the guidance, they will not ever follow the right course in that case.

verses.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُوْرُ ذُوْ الرَّحْمَةِ‌ ؕ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُمْ بِمَا كَسَبُوْا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ‌ ؕ بَلْ لَّهُمْ مَّوْعِدٌ لَّنْ يَّجِدُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مَوْئِلًا‏(58)
verses.translation: (58) And your Lord is Forgiving, the Lord of Mercy; were He to punish them for what they earn, He would certainly have hastened the chastisement for them; but for them there is an appointed time from which they shall not find a refuge.

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ الْقُرٰٓى اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوْا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِمْ مَّوْعِدًا‏(59)
verses.translation: (59) And (as for) these towns, We destroyed them when they acted unjustly, and We have appointed a time for their destruction.

verses.arabic: وَاِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِفَتٰٮهُ لَاۤ اَبْرَحُ حَتّٰۤى اَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ اَوْ اَمْضِىَ حُقُبًا‏(60)
verses.translation: (60) And when Musa said to his servant: I will not cease until I reach the junction of the two rivers or I will go on for years.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوْتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيْلَهٗ فِى الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا‏(61)
verses.translation: (61) So when they had reached the junction of the two (rivers) they forgot their fish, and it took its way into the sea, going away.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتٰٮهُ اٰتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِيْنَا مِنْ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَا نَصَبًا‏(62)
verses.translation: (62) But when they had gone farther, he said to his servant: Bring to us our morning meal, certainly we have met with fatigue from this our journey.

verses.arabic: قَالَ اَرَءَيْتَ اِذْ اَوَيْنَاۤ اِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَاِنِّىْ نَسِيْتُ الْحُوْتَ وَ مَاۤ اَنْسٰٮنِيْهُ اِلَّا الشَّيْطٰنُ اَنْ اَذْكُرَهٗ‌ ‌ۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيْلَهٗ فِىْ الْبَحْر‌ِ ‌ۖ عَجَبًا‏(63)
verses.translation: (63) He said: Did you see when we took refuge on the rock then I forgot the fish, and nothing made me forget to speak of it but the Shaitan, and it took its way into the river; what a wonder!

verses.arabic: قَالَ ذٰ لِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ‌‌ۖ  فَارْتَدَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا ۙ‏(64)
verses.translation: (64) He said: This is what we sought for; so they returned retracing their footsteps.

verses.arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَاۤ اٰتَيْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا وَعَلَّمْنٰهُ مِنْ لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا‏(65)
verses.translation: (65) Then they found one from among Our servants whom We had granted mercy from Us and whom We had taught knowledge from Ourselves.

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهٗ مُوْسٰى هَلْ اَتَّبِعُكَ عَلٰٓى اَنْ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا‏(66)
verses.translation: (66) Musa said to him: Shall I follow you on condition that you should teach me right knowledge of what you have been taught?

verses.arabic: قَالَ اِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيْعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا‏(67)
verses.translation: (67) He said: Surely you cannot have patience with me

verses.arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلٰى مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهٖ خُبْرًا‏(68)
verses.translation: (68) And how can you have patience in that of which you have not got a comprehensive knowledge?

verses.arabic: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ صَابِرًا وَّلَاۤ اَعْصِىْ لَكَ اَمْرًا‏(69)
verses.translation: (69) He said: If Allah pleases, you will find me patient and I shall not disobey you in any matter.

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَاِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِىْ فَلَا تَسْئَلْنِىْ عَنْ شَىْءٍ حَتّٰٓى اُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا‏(70)
verses.translation: (70) He said: If you would follow me, then do not question me about any thing until I myself speak to you about it

verses.arabic: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰۤى اِذَا رَكِبَا فِى السَّفِيْنَةِ خَرَقَهَا‌ ؕ قَالَ اَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ اَهْلَهَا‌ ۚ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا اِمْرًا‏(71)
verses.translation: (71) So they went (their way) until when they embarked in the boat he made a hole in it. (Musa) said: Have you made a hole in it to drown its inmates? Certainly you have done a grievous thing.

verses.arabic: قَالَ اَلَمْ اَقُلْ اِنَّكَ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيْعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًا‏(72)
verses.translation: (72) He said: Did I not say that you will not be able to have patience with me?

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِىْ بِمَا نَسِيْتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِىْ مِنْ اَمْرِىْ عُسْرًا‏(73)
verses.translation: (73) He said: Blame me not for what I forgot, and do not constrain me to a difficult thing in my affair.

verses.arabic: فَانْطَلَقَاحَتّٰۤى اِذَا لَقِيَا غُلٰمًا فَقَتَلَهٗ ۙ قَالَ اَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً ۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ ؕ لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا نُّكْرًا‏(74)
verses.translation: (74) So they went on until, when they met a boy, he slew him. (Musa) said: Have you slain an innocent person otherwise than for manslaughter? Certainly you have done an evil thing.
